Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions

TLDR

Keep Claude Code focused: irrelevant history is resent even when cached.

Start a new task with /clear. After completing a phase of the same task, use /compact, preferably before a long break.

Match both model size and reasoning effort to task difficulty, and set both before starting.

QuestionConclusionWhy
Switch settings?At session start or after /clear.Less history to reprocess.
Subagents?For noisy jobs.Extra turns add overhead.
Price baseline?Input 1xReads 0.1x; writes up to 2x; output ~5x.

Source: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
